![](asset:P000051-stem-1) A mass $m$ is oscillating on a smooth horizontal surface with an amplitude of A as shown. At the instant it is passing through the mean position, a blob of wax of mass $m$ is dropped on the block (it sticks to mass almost immediately).
(i) Find the new amplitude of oscillation.
(ii) If the blob of wax was dropped when the block was at x = +A/2, what would the new amplitude have been?
(iii) If the blob were dropped at x = +A, what would the new amplitude be? (The three cases are independent.)

assets.alt: A block m on a horizontal surface, joined to a wall by a spring of constant k and moving to the right. Three vertical markers below mark positions, the right-hand one labelled +A.
